text:
sam: seeing a big flurry of apiserver 503s from eu-west1 around 03:32 UTC, coincides with a GPU onboarding batch. apiserver log shows raft leadership ping gaps. anyone else?
ops-bot: ALERT: apiserver_error_rate > 5% in eu-west1 for last 3m. rolling window: 03:30-03:33 UTC.
maya: confirmed, grafana dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/r/Apiserver#eu-west1 - leader_election_latency spiked, etcd follower lag ~600-800ms.
devon: paste of /var/log/apiserver snippet: "W0320 03:32:15.123 controller_manager.go:xxx] failed to renew lease: etcdserver: request timed out". also seeing attach/detach timeouts from device-plugin logs.
lee: hmm device-plugin churn during onboarding often causes kubelet attach calls to spike which can make apiserver conn fanout increase. are these new node joins or just pod restarts?
sam: it's a batch of 120 new gpu nodes in the pool (dedicated) — onboarding job ran at 03:30. concurrency=30 by default.
anika: region nat gateways were high ~95% SNAT port usage per cloud metrics during that window, could be ephemeral port exhaustion causing TCP resets to apiserver/etcd endpoints.
maya: check kube-proxy conn counts and NAT metrics. if SNAT is the culprit, connections to etcd endpoints will get reset and raft heartbeats drop.
devon: running commands now: "kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l app=device-plugin -o wide" -> many device-plugin pods in CrashLoopBackOff with logs showing "Attach failed: context deadline exceeded".
lee: mitigation idea: pause onboarding (scale batch to 5), drain partially joined nodes, reduce kubelet attach concurrency, and open a short maintenance window for the NAT gateway team.
sam: doing scale down in onboarding job: set concurrency=5 and pause new node API calls. also told cloud to allocate extra NAT IPs.
anika: opened ticket with cloud infra: INC-4721 - increased ephemeral port range and requested temporary SNAT autoscale.
maya: also recommend to tweak etcd timeouts temporarily: increase election timeout by 2x on the small cluster to avoid leader flips while we stabilize. note: need rollout plan for controller-manager and apiserver config.
devon: quick diagnostic command if useful: ```ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl --endpoints=https://10.0.1.12:2379 endpoint status --write-out=table``` shows healthy but leader RTT jumped.
lee: can we enable apiserver circuit-breaker to limit watch fanout from device-plugin restarts? might buy us time.
sam: applied onboarding throttle, NAT respin in progress. monitoring for 10m. will post back.
ops-bot: UPDATE: apiserver_error_rate dropped to 1.2% after 4m. etcd follower lag back under 150ms.
maya: nice. long-term actions: (1) reduce default node onboarding concurrency for gpu pools, (2) add controlplane egress autoscale for high onboarding bursts, (3) add device-plugin backoff to avoid synchronized retries.
anika: and add smoke-test to onboarding pipeline that checks SNAT headroom before starting large batches.
devon: will open a short RFC for a knob in the onboarding job and add a canary batch step.
sam: thanks all — keeping this thread pinned until we have RFC and cloud confirm. :thumbsup:
